title: First Steps: Smart Coffee Kiosk
scenario: A smart coffee shop has a digital self-service kiosk. A Customer interacts with the kiosk to Order Coffee. A Barista in the back interacts with the system to Prepare Drink. Both use cases reside inside the Coffee Kiosk system boundary.
goal: Connect the Customer to "Order Coffee", and the Barista to "Prepare Drink" using standard UML Associations.
learningObjective: Understand Actors (outside the boundary), Use Cases (inside the boundary), and Associations (solid lines representing direct interaction).
hints: Actors represent external roles (human or system) interacting with use cases.
Connect the Customer actor to the "Order Coffee" use case using an Association.
Connect the Barista actor to the "Prepare Drink" use case using an Association.
solutionExplanation: In UML use case diagrams, actors interact with use cases using simple solid lines called Associations. Use cases live inside the system boundary, while actors remain outside.
